physics-m2-c.s.s1.prompt: [Nyocha circuit ọzọ] E jikọtara nguzogide 6 Ω na 3 Ω n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ma jikọọ ya na isi mmalite ike 12 V. Kedu ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik na-agafe circuit niile?

physics-killer-08.topic: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
physics-killer-08.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-08.material: Muon e mepụtara n'elu ikuku ụwa na-abịa kwụ ọtọ n'ala n'ọsọ $0.8c$. Ọ bụrụ na e were ụwa (ala) dị ka ntụaka, ịdị elu ebe e mepụtara ya bụ $800\,\mathrm{m}$, ma nkezi ndụ muon a tụrụ n'usoro izu ike ya bụ $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ọ bụrụ na $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ebe site n'ebe e mepụtara ya ruo n'ala dị ka a hụrụ n'usoro izu ike muon, na oge muon na-ewe ịgafe ebe ahụ?
physics-killer-08.thinking.0: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
physics-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Muon e mepụtara n'elu ikuku ụwa na-abịa kwụ ọtọ n'ala n'ọsọ $0.8c$. Ọ bụrụ na e were ụwa (ala) dị ka ntụaka, ịdị elu ebe e mepụtara ya bụ $800\,\mathrm{m}$, ma nkezi ndụ muon a tụrụ n'usoro izu ike ya bụ $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ọ bụrụ na $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ebe site n'ebe e mepụtara ya ruo n'ala dị ka a hụrụ n'usoro izu ike muon, na oge muon na-ewe ịgafe ebe ahụ?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.explain: $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.8^2}=5/3$. Mkpụmkpụ ogologo: $L=L_0/\gamma=800\cdot\dfrac35=480\,\mathrm{m}$. Oge $t=\dfrac{L}{v}=\dfrac{480}{0.8\cdot3\times10^8}=2.0\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s}=2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Nke a hà ndụ nke onwe muon. Onye na-ele anya n'ụwa na-akọwa otu ihe a site na ịgbatị oge: $\Delta t=\dfrac{800}{0.8c}=3.3\,\mu\mathrm{s}=\gamma\cdot2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ọ bụrụ na e mụbaa, $1333\,\mathrm{m}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e mụbaa site na $v/c$ kama $\gamma$, $640\,\mathrm{m}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); ọ bụrụ na e leghaara mkpụmkpụ anya, azịza na-ezighị ezi ④.
